data.fullPrompt: Remove Desk Chair completely. Remove Rolling Storage Cabinet completely. Remove Wall Letters completely. Remove Photo Garland completely. Keep #B8D4E8 — soft powder blue walls exactly as-is. Keep beige loop carpet floor exactly as-is. Warm japandi interior. White oak, cream linen, terracotta clay, brushed brass. White lacquered platform storage bed anchors the room as primary focal point, featuring integrated drawer compartments and low-profile footboard. Dark walnut floating nightstand with caramel leather pull and aged brass hardware positioned left of bed. Dark walnut vertical bookshelf 72 inches high with five open shelves and matte black metal uprights flanks right wall, balancing composition without competing with bed prominence. Foreground: geometric area rug in warm caramel and terracotta wool blend grounds bed frame. Caramel leather tufted pouf ottoman at foot of bed provides flexible seating. Midground: dark walnut table lamp with cream linen drum shade and aged brass base sits on nightstand. Two textured throw pillows in ochre and terracotta tones layered on bed with lightweight throw blanket draped naturally. Background: powder blue wall with preserved white cellular blinds. Dark walnut floating shelf 24 inches wide mounted left of window displaying curated ceramic objects and books in warm earth tones.
